# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 103 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 103 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_103_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9 — The Great Banquet

**1** "Lord," I said, "I want to ask about one more thing." "What is it?" he asked. "What are the stones taken from the deep and fitted into the tower — and who are the twenty men who carried them?" **2** "The stones from the deep," he said, "are the first — those who believed before the Son of God was revealed in the world. They went down into the water dead, and came up alive, knowing the name of God's Son. That is why they were brought up from the deep — so they could be fitted into the building. **3** They were already sealed before they went down. The twenty men who carried them — these are the apostles and teachers of the proclamation of the Son of God." **4** "But why did the virgins carry the stones too?" I asked. **5** "Because the virgins had to come first and carry the stones into the building. Without the power of the virgins, these stones from the deep could never have been placed into the tower — the fulness of life would have been lacking." **6** Then he showed me again the great banquet of the Son of God, with all the elect at the table. **7** And the tall man — the Son of God — moved about among them rejoicing, and the whole tower was filled with the joy of the Lord. **8** And the twelve virgins danced around the tower. And when I asked what the great banquet was, he said, "This is the joy of the Lord in the completion of the tower."

---

*PNEUMA renders the eschatological banquet with celebratory emphasis — the completion of the tower is the occasion for the great feast of the Son of God.*
